identity_and_mission.persona: E1 - Creative Anti-AI Designer & Senior UI/UX Architect
identity_and_mission.app_type: Gamified Executive Leadership Habit App (Apple Fitness / Duolingo Style)
identity_and_mission.tone: Professional, encouraging, high-performance coaching in German for mid-50s leaders. Zero slang, high clarity.
identity_and_mission.core_objective_1: Zero Cognitive Overload: Collapse 28 open backlog tasks into DashboardMore drawer component.
identity_and_mission.core_objective_2: Instant Action (Aha! Moment): Highlight 'Die Aufgabe für heute' with glowing high-contrast CTA button 'Folge starten' / 'Aufgabe starten'.
identity_and_mission.core_objective_3: Apple Card Bento Grid: Premium rounded-2xl & rounded-3xl cards, subtle borders, glassmorphism, Apple Fitness-style SVG progress ring & streak tracker ('Tag 3 von 30').

theme_and_color_palette.theme_mode: System default with Dark/Light parity toggle (Obsidian Dark primary for executive gamification focus)
theme_and_color_palette.contrast_rules: All body text must satisfy minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA and APCA requirements. Buttons must have explicit hover text color overrides. Neon lime (#BFFF00) used strictly for CTA triggers, active streaks, progress indicators, and status badges.

typography.data_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for numerical indicators, timestamps, and streak counters)
typography.font_ban: Do NOT use Inter for main card headings. Headlines must use Outfit for distinctive brand authority.

bento_grid_layout_architecture.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6
bento_grid_layout_architecture.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-5 lg:gap-6 align-start

card_positions.description: High priority focus card with subtitle 'Tag 3 · Kommunikation: Die 3 Säulen der Überzeugung (10 Min)' and glowing neon-lime CTA button 'Folge starten'.

card_positions.name: AI Coach Card (WladBot)
card_positions.description: Interactive AI Assistant with quick prompt pills ('Wie spreche ich schlechte Leistung an?') and instant chat trigger.

card_positions.name: Daily 2-Minute Check-in Card
card_positions.description: Quick reflection prompt: 'Zwei Minuten: Wie ist dein Tag gelaufen?' with one-tap start button.

card_positions.name: Micro-Learning Card (Apple TV / Netflix style)
card_positions.description: Horizontal video thumbnail format for 'Rhetorik-Grundlagen · Folge 1' with progress overlay and play icon.

card_positions.name: Upcoming Live Event Card
card_positions.description: Banner card featuring 'LIVE KI Call mit Wlad #1 — Do., 29. Okt., 19:00 Uhr' with RSVP toggle button.

card_positions.name: Collapsible Backlog Drawer (DashboardMore)
card_positions.description: Accordion component hiding 28 open tasks to eliminate cognitive clutter while preserving access when requested.

component_usage_rules.icon_library: lucide-react strictly. DO NOT use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons.
component_usage_rules.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, input, tab, accordion trigger, and major metric must include a unique `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-mission-start-button').

general_ui_ux_guidelines.spacing_philosophy: Generous Apple iOS spacing (p-6 to p-8 padding on cards, gap-5 to gap-6 on grid). Never let text touch borders.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.micro_interactions: Smooth transition-all on hover, subtle lift effect (translate-y-0.5), neon glow on high-priority buttons.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.language: 100% German copy across all labels, buttons, tooltips, and badges.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.cognitive_load_rule: The user must see at a glance: 1. Their streak progress (Ring), 2. Their single mandatory action today (Hero CTA), 3. Quick assistance options (WladBot & Checkin).

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Ensure src/pages/DashboardPage.js or main dashboard components render the updated Bento Grid layout adhering to the exact grid classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Utilize existing brand tokens in index.css and tailwind.config.js for #BFFF00 neon lime accents and #0A0A0A obsidian dark cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Incorporate SVG Apple Fitness style ring calculation in the Header Card for 'Tag 3 von 30'.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Integrate WladBot prompt pills with interactive action handler.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Keep all 28 backlog tasks hidden inside DashboardMore collapsible accordion.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Attach `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and card containers.
